major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it strictly on cooldown as your main burst window and dump every other cooldown into its debuff; its real cooldown is shorter than the tooltip thanks to Anger Management, so track the actual timer.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it shortly before or together with Colossus Smash; it has lost its follow-on talents so lining it up with Colossus Smash is its only real consideration.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it early inside the Colossus Smash debuff, either on cooldown or timed to a group of adds, rather than waiting for three stacks of Imminent Demise.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it just before Colossus Smash so its Cleave buff and other triggered effects line up with the burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Neither 152277 nor 228920 was observed in the sampled parses. 228920 is the cast id the SimC APL and the guide's opener prose both use; 152277 is the talent name row. Cooldown (90s) confirmed via WCL gameData + Wowhead tooltip during orchestrator validation.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it during Colossus Smash once Colossal Might is stacked, prioritizing alignment with Colossus Smash over using it strictly on cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses (Colossus hero-talent only); cooldown taken from the table's base_cd_s.

major_cooldowns.name: Wrecking Throw
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as a ranged filler when you cannot reach the target, and fire it immediately, second only to Colossus Smash, against absorb shields for its massive bonus damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Precast it before combat or use it on cooldown whenever multiple targets are up so the rest of your kit cleaves.

rule.description: Open with Charge into Avatar and Colossus Smash
rule.action: Charge in at the pull, land an opening Mortal Strike, then press Avatar just before Colossus Smash.
Start Bladestorm early inside the Colossus Smash window, not after it has fallen off.
Channel Demolish while Colossus Smash is active rather than on its own separate timer.

rule.description: Spend Sudden Death procs with Execute
rule.action: Fire Execute while Sudden Death is up rather than delaying it into overcapping the second stack.

rule.description: Overpower at two stacks of Opportunist
rule.action: Hold Overpower for two stacks of Opportunist rather than spending it early.

rule.description: Cleave becomes the main filler on several targets
rule.action: Switch your filler to Cleave once several targets are up; it also triggers your Slam and Heroic Strike effects automatically.

rule.description: Execute replaces Slam in execute range
rule.action: Drop Slam and pour rage into Execute once the target reaches execute range.
